title: Vignette 2026-11-04: the editor is how people experience the whole stack; essays are dogfood, and an essay is a presentation of the stack on our websites

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The editor now becomes the way that people experience our whole technical stack. The essays I write about our work should be dogfood. The essay view probably needs to become something I can plug into mudemocracy and semanticops websites. A blog post or, well, essay, should be a presentation of the stack.
